Won the Christmas tournament at Alma Center-Lincoln in double overtime. 8–6 in the Scenic Bluffs Conference, 4th place. Chris Tiona scored 322 points and pulled down 190 rebounds and was All-Conference 1st team; Todd Oliver was All-Conference 2nd team. Captains Todd Oliver and Chris Tiona. Offensive MVP and best rebounder Chris Tiona, defensive MVP Joel Torgerud, most improved Travis Hansen

Scenic Bluffs Conference Champions, sharing the title with Cashton at 12–2: Bangor's first conference title in 17 years and its first in the Scenic Bluffs. Averaged 71.3 points a game at home and allowed 53.6. Chris Tiona was All-Conference 1st team; Randy Tenner and Joel Torgerud 2nd team; Todd Oliver and Andy Kick honorable mention. Captains Todd Oliver and Chris Tiona. Offensive MVP Chris Tiona, defensive MVPs Randy Tenner and Joel Torgerud, most improved Andy Kick

Regional Champion & Sectional Finalist. 9–5 in the Scenic Bluffs Conference, 2nd behind Brookwood. Beat Brookwood in triple overtime for the regional title, then beat Eleva-Strum 70–69 in the sectional semifinal on Andy Kick's half-court shot at the buzzer; Kick scored 44 points with 7 of 9 three-pointers. Lost the sectional final to Southwestern, one win from the state tournament. Andy Kick was All-Conference 1st team and Travis Hansen 2nd team. Captains Andy Kick and Travis Hansen. Offensive MVP and best free-throw shooter Andy Kick, defensive MVP Paul Wittmershaus, best rebounder Travis Hansen, most improved Jason Rentz, spirit award Lyle Schaller

Jason Rentz was a unanimous All-Conference pick and Most Valuable Player. Captains Jason Rentz and Todd Michaels. Most improved Dave Garves, spirit award Jerry Peters, best rebounder Nathan Broers, best free-throw shooter Scott Herman. Dave Schaller, a 1985 Bangor graduate, coached the JV

6–8 in the Scenic Bluffs Conference. Offensive MVP and best free-throw shooter Scott Herman, defensive MVP and best rebounder Dave Garves, most improved Bruce Nuttleman, spirit award Steve Oesterle

7–7 in the Scenic Bluffs Conference, 3rd behind Necedah and Wonewoc. Started 0–5. Handed state-ranked Necedah its only regular-season loss on Pat Hansen's shot at the buzzer. Cory Nicolai was All-Conference and Pat Hansen honorable mention. Captains Mike Freit and Bruce Nuttleman. Offensive MVP and best rebounder Cory Nicolai, defensive MVP and best free-throw shooter Merlin Jones, most improved Bruce Nuttleman, spirit award Karl Bramschreiber
